samples.question: Each of the four bars rests on a red wedge, and blue blocks hang from the bar at its grey notches. A hanging load's turning effect is its number of blocks multiplied by how many notches it hangs away from the wedge. Exactly one bar has the same total turning effect on its left side as on its right side. Notch spacing differs from bar to bar, so count notches, not pixels. Which bar is the balanced one? The bars are numbered 1 to 4 from the top. Answer with exactly one of: beam-1, beam-2, beam-3, beam-4.
